thread:
Elena: Quick follow-up from today's pricing Q&A 94 drop specifics here and we'll action.

Theo: Two quick things: 1) if a customer is doing a staged migration across regions, do we count quota per org or per-region? 2) any recommended pre-migration checklist?

Nina: Answer: quota is org-scoped by default; region routing doesn't split buckets. For multi-region migrations you can request per-region buckets for complex chargeback, but that's manual setup with Sales/Support.

Omar: Migration checklist (short): notify account rep; request reservation window if >2x normal daily burn; enable predictive alerts; schedule smoothing if traffic will be bursty; confirm Dedicated capacity with infra if sustained throughput needed.

Theo: How long does a reservation request take to approve? We need SLA for planning.

Nina: Pilot approvals are currently 24-72h depending on billing sign-off. We're building self-serve in Console for Q2 which will be faster.

Elena: Backoff pattern reminder: exponential backoff + jitter, small retry budget per item. Avoid aggressive fan-out during replays. We'll add a migration playbook snippet to docs.

billing-bot: Internal doc draft: https://docs.redwood.ai/pricing/migration-playbook (internal) :link:

allhands-bot: Action: react with :thumbsup: if you want a canned migration checklist posted to the docs and tag @Nina for reservations.

Elena: Thanks everyone, we'll consolidate into a short FAQ and publish in the all-hands notes by EOD tomorrow.
